description: Read the legislation.gov.uk Publication Log for a date window of up to 31 days: new items, new revised versions, newly recorded effects, and withdrawals, newest first — the compliance-monitoring view of "what changed". Filter by content type, effect direction, category, an item or type/year, first-time items only, or event. With a full item path it reads that item's own log, usually in one call; otherwise it walks the window day by day, newest first, so a broad window may need several calls. A changes event carries no effect detail — uklaw_get_amendments with that item has it. Continue with next_cursor.

category.description: Item category: primary, secondary, or eu-origin. With content_type legislation or associated-documents only.

content_type.description: legislation (documents published), changes (effects recorded), draft, or associated-documents. Omit for all.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, passed with the other inputs unchanged; omit to start from end_date.

direction.description: With content_type changes only: effects recorded against (affected) or made by (affecting) the item.

end_date.description: Last event date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to start_date. The window is at most 31 days.

event.description: Only published or only withdrawn events. Omit for both.

item.description: A full item path (ukpga/2018/12) or legislation.gov.uk URI reads that item's own log; a type (uksi) or type and year (uksi/2026) narrows the day walk. Get a full path from uklaw_lookup_citation or uklaw_search_legislation.

limit.description: Most events returned by this call (1–80).

new_only.description: true: only events for items appearing on legislation.gov.uk for the first time.

start_date.description: First event date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD (UK local time).

name: uklaw_track_changes

attribution.description: Attribution lines the returned content requires (OGL always; EU and Westlaw credits when applicable).

days.description: Days touched by a day walk (empty in item-log mode).

pages_read.description: Pages of 20 events read for that day by this call.

total.description: Events legislation.gov.uk holds for that day and filter set; absent when not reported.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date`: start_date or end_date is shaped YYYY-MM-DD but is not a real calendar date. `invalid_window`: end_date is before start_date, or the window is over 31 days. `direction_needs_changes`: direction is set without content_type changes. `category_needs_content_type`: category is set without content_type legislation or associated-documents. `invalid_item`: item is not a (partial) item path or legislation.gov.uk URI, its type code is unknown, or it carries a provision. `invalid_cursor`: cursor does not decode, belongs to a different window, or holds a position no call over that window reaches (a day outside the window or after today, a day in item-log mode, a page past 10,000, or an offset past the end of its page). `filter_refused`: legislation.gov.uk answered the Publication Log feed with 404 or 400: a filter combination it does not accept. `upstream_refused`: legislation.gov.uk answered 403 or 429 (its fair use rate limit or a block). `pacer_shed`: The shared request queue cannot start this call within its deadline. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

category.description: Item category as legislation.gov.uk reports it; absent when not reported.

content_type.description: Content type: legislation, changes, draft, or associated-documents.

direction.description: Changes events only: affected or affecting.

document_uri.description: URI of the document version published; absent when the event names none.

format.description: Format published, e.g. xml or pdf; each format is its own event.

new.description: True when the item is new to legislation.gov.uk; absent when not reported.

newly_issued.description: True for a newly issued item; absent when not reported.

number.description: Item number; absent when not reported.

publisher.description: Who published the event, as legislation.gov.uk names them.

republished.description: True when a document was published again; absent when not reported.

resource_uri.description: The published resource (a document format, or the changes feed).

type.description: Type code of the item, e.g. uksi.

updated.description: Event time as legislation.gov.uk writes it (UK local time with offset, ISO 8601).

year.description: Calendar year of the item; absent when not reported.

has_more.description: True when more events remain in the window — call again with next_cursor.

item_log_total.description: Events in the item's whole log, all dates; present in item-log mode when reported.

mode.description: day_walk: per-day pages; item_log: one item's undated log.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to continue; present only when has_more is true.

notice.description: Guidance when the window is quiet or the list continues.

read_back_to.description: Item-log mode: date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the oldest event this call read from the item's log, which is read newest first. While it is after end_date, the read has not reached the window yet. Absent in a day walk and when no event read carries a calendar date.

truncated.description: True when the list was capped at limit.

end_date.description: Window end (YYYY-MM-DD), start_date when none was given.

title: Track legislation.gov.uk publications
